overview: A simple client-server architecture consisting of a static frontend web application that displays 'Hello World'. The frontend is a single-page application that serves static HTML content directly to visitors. No backend service is required as this is a pure static content display application.
requirements: The application must display the text 'Hello World' to all visitors
The page must load and display the message immediately without user interaction
The application must be accessible via web browsers on desktop devices
The application must be accessible via web browsers on mobile devices
The application must allow visitors to refresh the page and continue displaying the message
The application must respond with a 200 OK status for the root path
The application must include a /health endpoint for health checks

components.name: hello-world-web
components.openAPISpec:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Hello World Web Application
  version: 1.0.0
  description: A simple static web application that displays Hello World
paths:
  /:
    get:
      summary: Serve the main Hello World page
      description: Returns the HTML page displaying Hello World message
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Successfully returns the Hello World page
          content:
            text/html:
              schema:
                type: string
  /health:
    get:
      summary: Health check endpoint
      description: Returns health status of the web application
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Application is healthy
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status:
                    type: string
                    example: ok
components.componentAgentInstructions: Implement a React-based single-page application that displays 'Hello World'. Use TypeScript for type safety. Setup: Initialize a React app with TypeScript support using Vite or Create React App. The application should render a single centered text element containing 'Hello World'. Styling: Use CSS to center the text both horizontally and vertically on the page. Make the text large and readable (minimum 32px font size). Ensure responsive design that works on mobile (viewport width >= 320px) and desktop (viewport width >= 1024px). Use a clean, modern font. Health Endpoint: Implement a /health route that returns JSON {"status":"ok"} with 200 status. Server: Configure a production-ready static file server (use serve or nginx) that listens on port 8080. Dockerfile: Create a multi-stage build - stage 1 builds the React app (npm install, npm run build), stage 2 uses nginx:alpine to serve the built static files from /usr/share/nginx/html. Configure nginx to listen on port 8080 and serve index.html for all routes. Add a /health location in nginx config that returns the health check JSON. The container must expose port 8080. Testing: Ensure the page loads instantly, text is visible immediately, and refresh works correctly. Verify mobile and desktop responsiveness.
